cert.description: The certificate data in PEM format.

duration.description: amount of time the certificate should be valid for. Valid time units are seconds: "s", minutes: "m", hours: "h". Defaults to `8760h0m0s`.

early_renewal_duration.description: If set, the resource will consider the certificate to have expired the given durations before its actual expiry time. This can be useful to deploy an updated certificate in advance of the expiration of the current certificate. Note however that the old certificate remains valid until its true expiration time, since this resource does not (and cannot) support certificate revocation. Note also that this advance update can only be performed should the Terraform configuration be applied during the early renewal period.

groups.description: List of groups. This will limit which groups subordinate certs can use.

ips.description: List of IPv4 address and network in CIDR notation. This will limit which IPv4 addresses and networks subordinate certs can use for ip addresses.

key.description: The private key data in PEM format.

not_after.description: Certificate not valid after this date.

not_before.description: Certificate not valid after this date.

subnets.description: List of IPv4 address and network in CIDR notation. This will limit which IPv4 addresses and networks subordinate certs can use in subnets.

block.description: Create a self signed certificate authority

ca_cert.description: The signing CA certificate data in PEM format.

ca_key.description: The signing CA private key data in PEM format.

cert.description: The certificate data in PEM format.

duration.description: how long the cert should be valid for. The default is 1 second before the signing cert expires. Valid time units are seconds: "s", minutes: "m", hours: "h".

early_renewal_duration.description: If set, the resource will consider the certificate to have expired the given durations before its actual expiry time. This can be useful to deploy an updated certificate in advance of the expiration of the current certificate. Note however that the old certificate remains valid until its true expiration time, since this resource does not (and cannot) support certificate revocation. Note also that this advance update can only be performed should the Terraform configuration be applied during the early renewal period.

ip.description: IPv4 address and network in CIDR notation to assign the cert.

key.description: The private key data in PEM format. Empty if `public_key` is specified.

name.description: Name of the cert, usually a hostname.

not_after.description: Certificate not valid after this date.

not_before.description: Certificate not valid after this date.

public_key.description: The previously generated public key data in PEM format.

subnets.description: List of ipv4 address and network in CIDR notation. Subnets this cert can serve for.
